title: Container engineering
summary: Diagnose and deliver the containerized Dispatch system with persistent data, networking, and a hardened image.
reason: This benchmark exercises a complete Docker system rather than a command-recognition quiz.

title: Kubernetes application development
summary: Operate the application through configuration, storage, routing, safe rollouts, and distinct health probes.
reason: Successful container work does not by itself establish Kubernetes application skills.

title: Platform engineering and security
summary: Integrate delivery, observability, capacity, and least-privilege security around the evolving application.
reason: The benchmark requires useful application behavior while preserving the intended operational boundaries.

title: Cluster administration
summary: Recover and hand off the native cluster with retained state, a controlled release, and explicit operating decisions.
reason: This is an advanced four-VM benchmark. Start it only when you want to assess the administration phase.
